### Changed
- **`components.agent-manager.versionRange` is `>=2.1.0 <3.0.0` (was `>=1.13.0 <2.0.0`), the connectivity release's `agent-manager migrate` run takes agent-manager 2.1.0, and the customer BOM pins it.** `get_session` answers a bounded summary by default (`detail: full` for every task) beside the new `get_session_turn` and `delete_session` (giantswarm/agent-manager#150, #155); `get_info` lists in `namespaces.managed` only the namespaces where the caller may create agents (giantswarm/agent-manager#71); an agent on a claude Harness without a `harness.egress` entry is refused, naming the entry (giantswarm/agent-manager#148). The tenant reconciler ships off (`agent-manager.tenants.enabled`). Supersedes giantswarm/agent-platform#1001.
